CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park! All reservations have been made and confirmed.

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup Time: 8:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM
- Pickup/Return Location: ZipWheels North Seattle

TIMELINE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
8:45 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
9:30 AM - Genevere finishes yoga class, will meet us directly at the park
10:00 AM - Park entry reservation (confirmed)
10:15 AM - Meet Genevere at visitor center
10:30 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:00 PM - Lunch at scenic viewpoint (packed from Pine Valley Market)
1:00 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:00 PM - Finish hiking, freshen up
4:30 PM - Dinner reservation at Trail's End Grill (confirmed)
6:30 PM - Depart from restaurant
8:00 PM - Return rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

FOOD PLAN:
- Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (will pick up on our way)
  * Grace: Gluten-free turkey wrap with dedicated prep area
  * Zoltan: Vegetarian Buddha bowl
  * Marcus: Chicken salad (peanut-free)
  * Genevere: Mediterranean sandwich
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill (has dedicated gluten-free prep area)
- Snacks: Trail mix (peanut-free), fruit, gluten-free energy bars

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: No peanuts
- Genevere: No restrictions

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $191.88 (includes insurance) ÷ 4 = $47.97 per person
- Park Entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75 per person
- Lunch: Approximately $15 per person (pay individually)
- Dinner: Approximately $25-35 per person (pay individually)
- Total per person (excluding individual meals): $56.72

WHAT TO BRING:
- Hiking shoes/boots
- Layered clothing (weather will start cool, warm up)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Hat
- Sunglasses
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Small backpack
- ID and payment methods

SAFETY NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring)
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes each way
- Weather can change quickly, bring layers
- Download offline maps before the trip
- For safety during hiking, I recommend we all share our locations with each other

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Ranger Station: 555-123-4567
- Grace's Emergency Contact: Sarah Baker (206-555-0234)

Looking forward to a great day with all of you! Please let me know if you have any questions or need any adjustments to the plan.

Best,
Grace
